name: Etza
source:
Pronouns: They/Them
Occupation: Wyvern (Healer)

Likes: Poetry, art, peace
Dislikes: Greed, harm to nature
Hobbies: Reading, painting, mediation, going on walks through nature

Powers: Energy Regeneration, Elemental Control
Signature Technique: Energy Connection. Etza's healing abilities are considered virtually unrivaled. What makes their healing ability unique is that they have the ability to sense dragon energy.
Dragon Spring: Quetzalcoatl

The head Wyvern at Central, Etza is a renowned and powerful leader. They seem to be both the head healer and scholar at Central, worthy of their position as the head Wyvern. Similar to Kayn, Etza is often surrounded by admirers. However, the admiration for Etza seems to stem from their dedication to helping others' well-being. Impressive, given the sheer number.

Etza is your main partner while at Central. Is it intimidating to work with someone of their caliber? Regardless, they seem to have treated you with nothing but respect since you've been at Central. Even with their many responsibilities, they consistently ensure their support for you.

[From in-game profile]
